title: 第9章 参团率100%的卡牌
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

米勒的声音响起：“新人Tree选手的卡牌此刻就像是在用一根看不见的线，玩弄着VG全体成员的神经。

你永远猜不到卡牌的大招会落在哪里，所以你必须在每一条边线上都保持最高级别的戒备。

最让人抓狂的是，卡牌不需要真的交出大招，只要他从视野里消失两秒，无形的威慑力就已经把VG的阵型扯动得七零八落。”

米勒深吸了一口气，由衷地感叹道：“Tree这个卡牌，把心理学玩到了极致，他几乎是把VG的阵型完全拉扯烂了。”

娃娃接话道：“而且你发现没有，LGD现在一点都不着急，和之前的LGD有着天壤之别。”

比赛席上，VG的几名选手脸色已经开始明显发青。打职业的人最怕遇到这种局，你知道自己在慢性死亡，你知道每一个决策都在掉血，可你偏偏找不到任何反打和开团的机会。

卡牌这个英雄在陈周手里，变成了一个无解的单选框——守上，下路就得掉；守下，中路野区就会被全部蚕食。

最折磨的是，龙区现在一片漆黑，虽然LGD刚才没打，但大龙依旧是随时会引爆的定时炸弹，逼着VG每隔十几秒就要用人命去确认一次。

可只要有人试图往河道摸索，那个挥之不去的金色身影就会再次从阴影里隐去。

二十七分钟，紧绷到极限的VG终于彻底破防。

辅助牛头开启扫描，顶着巨大的心理压力一步步往河道挪动，试图为队伍重新抢回一丝大龙坑的视野。

可就在他的身躯刚刚踏进河道草丛的瞬间，黄牌毫无预兆地从迷雾深处破空飞出。

卡牌，又在这里。

“我的天！！”娃娃都被气笑了，“Tree到底是怎么做到的？他为什么哪里都在啊？！”

牛头瞬间被定在原地，随即开大招脱离控制。

紧接着，布隆大招跟上，将其死死控住。

哪怕有大招，经济的差距也让吃牛肉变得轻而易举。

这一次，VG的队友连看都不敢往河道多看一眼。

因为大屏幕的另一端，MaRin的剑姬已经上高地了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Miller's voice sounded: "The cards of the new player Tree are like using an invisible thread to play with the nerves of all VG members.

You never guess where the card's ultimate move will land, so you must maintain the highest level of vigilance on every sideline.

The most maddening thing is that the card does not need to actually use his ultimate move. As long as he disappears from the field of view for two seconds, the invisible deterrent force has already shaken VG's formation to pieces."

Miller took a deep breath and sighed sincerely: "The card Tree has taken psychology to the extreme. He almost completely tore up VG's formation."

Wawa continued: "And have you noticed that LGD is not in a hurry now, which is completely different from the previous LGD."

At the competition table, several VG players' faces were starting to turn visibly blue.Professional players are most afraid of encountering this kind of situation. You know that you are slowly dying, and you know that every decision you make is losing blood, but you can't find any opportunities to counterattack or start a team.

In the hands of Chen Zhou, the card hero has become an unsolvable radio button - if you defend the top, you will have to drop it in the bottom lane; if you defend the bottom lane, the middle jungle area will be completely cannibalized.

The most torturous thing is that the Dragon Zone is now dark. Although LGD didn't fight just now, the Baron is still a time bomb that can explode at any time, forcing VG to use his life to confirm it every ten seconds.

But as long as someone tries to explore the river, the lingering golden figure will disappear from the shadows again.

At twenty-seven minutes, VG, which was stretched to its limit, finally completely broke through the defense.

Assisting Niutou to start scanning, he moved step by step towards the river under huge psychological pressure, trying to regain a glimpse of the Dalong Pit for the team.

But the moment his body stepped into the grass in the river, the yellow card flew out of the air from the depths of the mist without warning.

Cards, here again.

"Oh my God!!" The dolls laughed in anger, "How did Tree do it? Why is he everywhere?!"

The bull's head was instantly frozen in place, and then he used his ultimate move to get out of control.

Immediately afterwards, Braum followed up with his ultimate move and tightly controlled him.

Even with the ultimate move, the economic gap makes it easy to eat beef.

This time, VG’s teammates didn’t even dare to take another look at the river.

Because on the other side of the big screen, MaRin's Sword Girl has already reached the high ground.
